description:
This post is for market research purposes only. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SOURCES SOUGHT. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this synopsis or any follow up information requests.

MHAFB is gauging the interest of total small business set aside with further potential set aside into socioeconomic categorys.

Contracting is requiring the removal of two boilers, one located in Bldg. 2310 and the other in Bldg. 1610 and replaced with new units. The following work shall be IAW with manufacture instructions in conjunction with the SOW.

The contractor shall furnish and install two Lochinvar boilers or equal with the following required features to replace existing equipment.  The minimum salient characteristics of the boiler are as follows.              

    1. Bldg. 2310 Lochinvar KnightXL Model KBX-1000N-M13 (1 EA) or equal.
    2. Bldg. 1610 Lochinvar KnightXL Model KBX-0400N (1 EA) or equal.
    3. Minimum 7” touchscreen LCD display
    4. 97% Thermal Efficiency
    5. Flow Switch
    6. Condensate trap Neutralizer
    7. 10:1 Turndown Modulating burner

All IAW the statement of work (SOW). 

The magnitude of this project is between $ 25,000 to $100,000.

In order to reduce chances of missed emails, the Subject line shall be "B1610 & B2310 Boilers Sources Sought Response"

Each company’s response to this Sources Sought shall be a maximum of 3 pages and shall include the following information:

  • Company name
  • CAGE code
  • Address
  • Point of Contact
  • Phone Number
  • E-mail address
  • Company's Small business category (Small Business, Woman-Owned Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business [SDB] to include the 8(a) Program, Historically Underutilized Business Zones [HUBZone], Service- Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business [SDVOSB]).
  • A brief statement of the company's interest in bidding on the project as well as details of the company's capability to perform a contract of this type, magnitude, and complexity
